Approval ControlCurrent Standard
Supplier approval recordSUPPLIER-2026-001
SupplierGolden Harvest Produce Co. Ltd.
CategoryFresh garlic and ginger
PurposeGive the founder one supplier-governance surface that connects approval posture, performance proof, backup-source depth, traceability, CAPA exposure, shipment release dependency, funding discipline, and continuity risk before Golden Harvest becomes a wider operating dependency.
Primary lensApproval confidence before wider supplier dependence.
Decision nowDecide whether Golden Harvest should remain approved with controls, whether dependence should narrow, or whether backup sourcing and evidence closure need to advance before future release confidence widens.
Source ruleUpdate supplier room, supplier performance module, backup sourcing module, supplier release packet, shipment review, traceability room, CAPA and claims records, supplier performance board, supply resilience board, trust matrix, funding review, scenario, and risk records first, then refresh this approval brief.
Founder ruleDo not treat useful supplier execution, current scorecard support, or active release participation as institutional confidence until performance proof, response quality, fallback coverage, traceability, and live shipment controls carry one current answer.

Founder Decision AgendaLink

SequenceFounder QuestionRequired ReadingDecision Output
First passDo supplier records carry one approval answer?Compare supplier room, approval brief, performance module, and supplier performance board.Keep approved with controls and refresh source alignment before confidence improves.
Second passIs performance proof current enough for active use?Review supplier performance module, supplier release packet, response escalation board, and shipment review.Continue governed use only if response timing and execution proof remain current.
Third passIs backup coverage strong enough for dependence?Review backup sourcing module, supply resilience board, concentration review, and risk register.Keep resilience watch active until coverage, concentration, and recovery window improve.
Fourth passIs quality proof strong enough for future confidence?Review traceability, complaint, CAPA, claims recovery, and supplier performance board.Keep approval bounded until evidence gap and CAPA/recovery consequences are resolved.
Fifth passCan release or funding confidence widen?Review supplier release packet, funding review, pre-shipment release, executable-check, scenario, and risk.Block wider movement unless live gate proof matches.
